headline: Approved January meeting minutes with edits and reviewed brochure and outreach plans for 2026
summary: The Police Community Advisory Council approved the January meeting minutes pending edits and discussed community feedback on flock cameras and data sharing with other departments. The council reviewed outreach goals, working groups, a draft brochure, and plans for yearly chair and vice chair elections expected in June 2026.
decisions: Approved January meeting minutes with one edit, motion by Chloe, seconded by Kevin S., approved by the rest of the council pending edits.
Approved two versions of the brochure with edits, to be revised and sent to the city for printing.
